gen.title: Gas laws and the ideal gas relationship

cards.stem: Which name is given to the pressure and volume relationship described in the quote?
cards.quote: This relationship between pressure and volume is called Boyle’s Law in honor of Robert Boyle who first observed it in 1660.
cards.hint: Use the name given in the quoted sentence.

cards.stem: What property is defined as the ratio of mass to volume?
cards.quote: This allows us to define a single additional property called the gas density rho (ρ), which is the ratio of mass to volume.
cards.hint: Think about which property compares mass and volume.

cards.stem: How is the pressure-volume product described for an ideal gas?
cards.quote: The product of pressure and volume is exactly a constant for an ideal gas.
cards.hint: Compare exactly versus nearly for an ideal gas.

cards.stem: What type of temperature must be used in the equation of state?
cards.quote: Also be aware that the temperature given in the equation of state must be an absolute temperature that begins at absolute zero.
cards.hint: Recall which temperature scale starts at absolute zero.
